units.title: Introduction, Raw Materials and Surface Preparation
topics: 1.1. Introduction to Ceramic Coatings • Define ceramic coatings and surface engineering • Classification: Protective coatings, Decorative coatings, Functional coatings (thermal, electrical, wear-resistant) • Applications in ceramic industries (tiles, sanitaryware, refractories)

1.2. Raw Materials for Coatings  Binders: clay, frits, resins  Solvents/mediums: water, organic solvents  Additives: Dispersants, Plasticizers, Deflocculants, Stabilizers  Pigments & opacifiers: Metal oxides (Fe₂O₃, CoO, Cr₂O₃) , Zircon, titania
1.3. Surface Preparation  Importance of surface preparation  Methods: Mechanical cleaning (grinding, polishing), Chemical cleaning (acid/alkali treatment), Degreasing, Roughening techniques
1.4. Batch Calculations  Calculation of coating composition

units.title: Coating Techniques
topics: 2.1. Conventional Methods  Dip coating: Principle and process steps, Factors affecting thickness  Spray coating: Types: air spray, airless spray, Advantages and limitations  Spin coating: Principle and applications (thin films)
2.2. Glazing and Enamelling  Definition of glaze

units.title: Drying and Firing
topics: 3.1. Drying of Coatings  Stages of drying: Constant rate period, Falling rate period  Factors affecting drying: Temperature, Humidity, Air velocity
3.2. Firing of Coatings  Firing cycles and temperature profiles  Interaction between coating and substrate  Role of kiln atmosphere
3.3. Defects in Coatings  Cracking  Peeling  Blistering  Pinholes  Crawling
3.4. Remedies  Process control  Material adjustment  Proper drying and firing schedule

units.title: Properties and Testing
topics: 4.1. Physical Properties  Adhesion strength  Hardness  Thickness  Porosity
4.2. Mechanical & Chemical Properties  Wear resistance  Corrosion resistance  Thermal stability  Chemical resistance
4.3. Testing Methods  Adhesion test (scratch/tape test)  Hardness test (Mohs, Vickers)  Thickness measurement (micrometer, coating gauge)  Thermal shock resistance test

units.title: Types of Coatings and Applications
topics: 5.1. Types of Ceramic Coatings  Protective coatings  Decorative coatings  Thermal barrier coatings (TBC)  Electrical insulating coatings
5.2. Industrial Applications  Tiles and sanitaryware glazing  Refractory coatings  Aerospace thermal coatings  Biomedical coatings
5.3. Selection of Coatings  Based on: Temperature resistance, Chemical environment, Mechanical requirements, Cost and durability
